Definitively stuck. Let me record this as a durable fact and think about whether there's any recovery.

Actually, let me reconsider one more time. The notice board "blocks" and is at (2,7). What if the notice board is a solid object and I'm standing on the SAME tile because the game spawned me there, but the collision only blocks movement INTO solid tiles — and since I'm already on a solid tile, moving to an adjacent non-solid tile should be allowed. But it's not.

Unless... the game checks "is the destination tile solid?" — (2,8) is '.', not solid. So moving down should work. But it doesn't. So maybe the game checks "am I currently on a solid tile? If so, block all movement." That's the trap.

Let me try pressing E to interact with the notice board — maybe reading it is the ONLY way and it's a special interaction. The E presses report "nothing-there" for the tile I'm facing. But maybe I need to face the board. Since the board is on my tile, maybe facing "into" it isn't possible.

Let me try: what if the notice board is actually at (2,7) but I'm at (2,7) and the game wants me to press E to READ it, and the "nothing-there" is because E checks the tile in front, not my own tile. So I need to be adjacent to read it. But I can't get adjacent because I'm on it.

This is a catch-22. Let me try waiting a very long time — maybe a scripted rescue or the player pushes me.
